name: Morphing Julia Set
desc: A connected, filled Julia set whose seed constant orbits the main cardioid so the whole fractal perpetually morphs from fat spiraling lobes to seahorse filaments, its non-escaping interior glowing electric blue-violet while gold escape filaments trace the boundary.

scale.doc: zoom into the fractal (higher = deeper detail)

speed.doc: morph rate of the orbiting c

morph.doc: orbit radius: low=fat filled lobes, high=spiny filaments

seed.doc: deterministic variation of orbit phase + hue offset
